name: TC-BF-002 — Brief提交前必填字段校验 [P0]
description: 验证Brief提交时必填校验：迭代名称、风格定位(20-200字)、上新节奏、对标店铺、参考视觉图、首次试拍商品(10条)

steps.expression: (() => { const submitBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('提交产运确认') || b.textContent.includes('提交')); if (submitBtn) { submitBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 空表单点击提交触发校验

steps.expression: (() => { const errors = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-form-item-explain, [class*=error]')).map(e => e.textContent.trim()).filter(e => e.length > 0); const firstError = document.querySelector('.ant-form-item-explain-error, [class*=error]'); return { errorCount: errors.length, errors: errors.slice(0, 10), hasFirstError: !!firstError }; })()

(() => { const styleField = document.querySelector('textarea, [class*=textarea]'); if (styleField) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(styleField, '短'); styleField.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return { input: '短', length: 1 }; } return { found: false }; })()
steps.description: 风格定位输入少于20字测试最小长度

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在DRAFT_BRIEF状态迭代，当前用户是买手
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 空表单直接点提交
2. 验证必填字段错误提示
3. 风格定位输入少于20字验证
4. 品类占比合计不到100%验证
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 必填字段缺失时展示错误提示
2. 风格定位少于20字提示不满足
3. 对标店铺少于1家提示
4. 参考视觉图少于1张提示
5. 首次试拍商品少于10条提示
6. 页面滚动到第一个错误字段
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/Brief协作
